_comment: Enhancements use each emulator's native keys (verified against source, see Data/research/enhancements.md). 'perGame' replaces 'on' inside per-game profiles. Ids ending in .hdtextures are switched on automatically when a texture pack is installed.

enhancements.name: No-interlacing patches
enhancements.description: Removes interlacing flicker and softness in games that have a patch. Cheap, and sharper on a small screen.

enhancements.name: Widescreen 16:9 patches
enhancements.description: Real 16:9 rendering for games with a widescreen patch (fills the Ally's screen without stretching). A few games show HUD or culling glitches.

enhancements.name: AMD CAS sharpening
enhancements.description: Contrast Adaptive Sharpening on the final image. Makes upscaled PS2 games look crisper at very little cost.

enhancements.name: FXAA anti-aliasing
enhancements.description: Smooths jagged edges. Softens the image a little; best combined with CAS sharpening.

enhancements.name: Load HD texture packs
enhancements.description: Loads replacement textures from textures\<serial>\replacements (switched on automatically when you install a pack).

enhancements.name: Preload HD textures into RAM
enhancements.description: Loads a whole texture pack when the game starts to avoid pop-in. Uses a lot of memory; better on 24 GB models.

enhancements.name: Widescreen hack (16:9)
enhancements.description: Renders 3D games in 16:9 instead of stretching. Works well for most 3D titles; 2D backgrounds stay 4:3.

enhancements.name: Sharpening shader
enhancements.description: DuckStation's built-in simple-sharpen post-processing shader (DuckStation has no FSR/CAS). Replaces your first post-processing stage.

enhancements.name: Load HD texture packs
enhancements.description: Enables the texture cache and texture/background replacements from textures\<serial>\replacements. Needs a hardware renderer (the default).

enhancements.name: Preload HD textures
enhancements.description: Loads the whole texture pack up front to avoid stutter when new textures appear.

enhancements.name: AMD FSR 1 upscaling + sharpening
enhancements.description: PPSSPP's built-in FSR-EASU upscaler followed by FSR-RCAS sharpening. Gives a sharp 1080p image even from a lower internal resolution.

enhancements.name: Texture upscaling (4x xBRZ on the GPU)
enhancements.description: Smooths low-resolution PSP textures with a GPU xBRZ shader. Looks great in 2D/anime games; costs some GPU time.

enhancements.name: Load HD texture packs
enhancements.description: Loads packs from PSP\TEXTURES\<game id> (on by default in PPSSPP).

enhancements.name: Widescreen hack (16:9)
enhancements.description: Forces 16:9 rendering in games without native widescreen. Can cause culling at the screen edges; games with a 16:9 option don't need it.

enhancements.name: Sharp output resampling
enhancements.description: Uses Sharp Bilinear when scaling the rendered image to the screen: crisper than the default when the internal resolution doesn't match 1080p.

enhancements.name: FXAA post-processing
enhancements.description: Dolphin's built-in FXAA shader to smooth edges (Dolphin doesn't ship an FSR/CAS shader).

enhancements.name: Load HD texture packs
enhancements.description: Loads custom textures from Load\Textures\<game id> (switched on automatically when you install a pack).

enhancements.name: Prefetch HD textures
enhancements.description: Loads the entire texture pack into RAM at boot so textures never pop in. Big packs need a lot of memory.

enhancements.name: AMD FSR 1 upscaling + CAS sharpening
enhancements.description: Upscales RPCS3's output with FidelityFX Super Resolution (Vulkan) and sharpens it. A cheap way to get a crisp 1080p image from a 720p render.

enhancements.name: Apply game patches
enhancements.description: Lets Xenia load the community game patches (60 FPS, resolution, fixes). Turn individual patches on per game in the Game Library.

addons.name: RPCS3 official game patches
addons.description: The patch database from rpcs3.net (60 FPS unlocks, resolution fixes, bug fixes) – the same file RPCS3's Patch Manager downloads. Turn patches on in RPCS3 → Manage → Game Patches.

addons.name: Cemu community graphic packs
addons.description: Resolution upscaling, 60 FPS, widescreen and fix packs for Wii U games from the official cemu_graphic_packs project. Pick a pack and preset per game in Cemu → Options → Graphic packs.

addons.name: Xenia Canary game patches
addons.description: Community patches for ~500 Xbox 360 games (60 FPS, resolution, bug fixes) from xenia-canary/game-patches. Patches you've turned on stay on when the pack updates.
